summary: A 25-year-old Boulder woman fell and injured her leg on the steep Anne U. White Trail ~2 mi NW of Boulder; bystanders carried her ~1.25 mi down the trail until other park visitors called 911; Boulder Mountain Fire Protection District, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Pridemark Ambulance and a Boulder County sheriff's deputy responded, and RMRG members evacuated her to Boulder Community Hospital
location: Anne U. White Trail, NW of Boulder
responding_agency: Boulder Mountain Fire Protection District (with Rocky Mountain Rescue Group)
notes: DATE PIN — BW police blotter (parent-opened run 632): 'approximately 3:15 p.m. on April 18'; Sunday-verified; Pridemark-era ambulance (pre-2012 contract) nails year as 2010; zero Boulder 2010-04-18 rows before insert.
